Name: Sandra - A Manipulative New NPC (Marriageable) Safe Edition
Author: wxunlimited
Description:
[center][color=#e69138][size=6][b]The Cunning Guest: Sandra[/b][/size][/color]
[i]Your grandfather's "long-lost step-aunt" arrives on your doorstep with a suitcase and a plan.[/i][/center]

[line]
[size=5][url=https://ko-fi.com/wxunlimited]Buy me a Ko-Fi / Support me:[/url][/size]
[img width=494]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54216/54216-1793180802-647047857.jpg[/img]
[img width=411]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54216/54216-1792576509-1033232734.png[/img]
[color=#e69138][size=4][b]About[/b][/size][/color]
Sandra moves into your farmhouse, charming, helpful and very interested in your property. Is she family, a con artist, or something more complicated? Her story plays out over years through heart events, side stories with the villagers, letters, a court hearing and several endings, including a hard-won True Ending.

[b]Adult themes:[/b] romance and mature storylines. Every character is an adult.

[line]
[youtube]QI927uor9TE[/youtube]


[color=#e69138][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]A full story NPC[/b] who lives in your farmhouse: heart events, side stories (Clint, Haley, Marnie, Gus, Abigail, Lewis and more), letters and multiple endings.[/*]
[*][b]Suspicion and scheme systems:[/b] keep an eye on her and she behaves; ignore her and money, crops and town gossip start to suffer (each can be turned off).[/*]
[*][b]Night menu[/b] (from 8 PM in the farmhouse): cook together, talk, go on dates and more.[/*]
[*][b]The Hearing:[/b] a courtroom minigame at the heart of the story.[/*]
[*][b]True Ending[/b] with an in-game checklist. Press [b]K[/b] (or click the left stick, or use the Wardrobe touch button) near Sandra and choose [b]Case notes / True Ending[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Three difficulties[/b] chosen in the story, per save: [b]Casual[/b] (forgiving), [b]Normal[/b] and [b]Brutal[/b] (one serious mistake closes the True Ending).[/*]
[*][b]Romance and marriage[/b], with her own spouse room.[/*]
[*][b]Bedtime:[/b] she sleeps in the farmer's bed at night (the free half of a double bed).[/*]
[*][b]Seasonal wardrobe[/b] with 18 outfits, jewelry and a smooth evening outfit change.[/*]
[*][b]Festivals:[/b] she attends all eight, including with Stardew Valley Expanded.[/*]
[*]HD sprite, full-size portraits, and controller and touch support.[/*]
[/list][color=#e69138][size=4][b]Sandra's daily schedule[/b][/size][/color]
Sandra lives in your farmhouse. Each day is planned in the morning in five blocks:
[list]
[*][b]6:00 AM to 9:00 AM:[/b] at home (breakfast, tea, tidying up).[/*]
[*][b]9:00 AM to 12:00 PM:[/b] an outing (see below).[/*]
[*][b]12:00 PM to 1:00 PM:[/b] back home for lunch.[/*]
[*][b]1:00 PM to 5:30 PM:[/b] another outing.[/*]
[*][b]5:30 PM onward:[/b] at home for the evening (cooking, reading, TV, by the window).[/*]
[*][b]8:00 PM onward:[/b] the night menu opens. Click her in the farmhouse to cook, talk, go on a date and more.[/*]
[*][b]10:00 PM:[/b] she goes to bed and sleeps in the farmer's bed (configurable with BedTime).[/*]
[/list]
[b]Where she goes on outings[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Rain, snow, storms, green rain and festival days:[/b] she stays home all day. On festival days she attends the festival itself.[/*]
[*][b]Spring, summer and fall:[/b] about 55% around the farm (porch, crops, animals, mailbox, pets), 25% in town (shops, the square, a stroll), 20% at home.[/*]
[*][b]Winter:[/b] about 35% farm, 15% town, 50% home.[/*]
[*][b]She never spends both outings in town on the same day.[/b] If the morning was in town, the afternoon is on the farm.[/*]
[/list]Set [b]DailyRoutine: false[/b] in the Core config if you'd rather she stayed in the farmhouse.

[line]
[color=#e69138]
[size=4][b]Events guide[/b][/size][/color]
[b]General rules for all story scenes[/b]
[list]
[*]Only [b]one story scene per day[/b] (the MaxStoryScenesPerDay setting). If one already played today, the next waits until tomorrow.[/*]
[*]No story scenes during festivals or while another event is running.[/*]
[*]Hearts are your friendship hearts with Sandra.[/*]
[*]How scenes trigger:
[list]
[*][b]Enter:[/b] walk into the location during the time window.[/*]
[*][b]Near:[/b] be close to the spot named.[/*]
[*][b]On waking:[/b] the morning you wake up at home.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[spoiler]
[b]Arrival[/b]
[list]
[*][b]The Doorstep Scheme:[/b] near your farmhouse door, 6 AM to 12 PM, on a sunny non-festival day, from Spring 5.[/*]
[*][b]The House Tour She Gave Herself:[/b] straight after, when you go inside. You choose your difficulty here.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Heart events[/b]
[list]
[*][b]1 heart, The Grocery Tab:[/b] enter Pierre's shop 9 AM to 5 PM, once you've known her for 3+ days.[/*]
[*][b]2 hearts, The Saloon Sympathy Act:[/b] enter the Saloon 4 PM to 7 PM.[/*]
[*][b]3 hearts, The Family Tree:[/b] near the Mayor's manor 9 AM to 4 PM (after the 2-heart event).[/*]
[*][b]3 hearts, The Borrowed Necklace:[/b] the town square 12 PM to 3 PM (after the 2-heart event).[/*]
[*][b]4 hearts, Midnight Rummaging:[/b] be in the farmhouse 11 PM to 2 AM.[/*]
[*][b]5 hearts, Midnight Gaslighting:[/b] on waking, 2+ days after the 4-heart event.[/*]
[*][b]5 hearts, Ashes in the Fireplace:[/b] on waking, 2+ days after the 5-heart event.[/*]
[*][b]6 hearts, The Town Council Warning:[/b] near the Mayor's manor 10 AM to 3 PM.[/*]
[*][b]6 hearts, Practice Makes Perfect:[/b] on waking, 2+ days after the 6-heart event.[/*]
[*][b]7 hearts, The Poisoned Well:[/b] on your farm on a [b]Monday[/b], 6 AM to 11 AM.[/*]
[*][b]7 hearts, The Second Visitor:[/b] enter the Bus Stop 9 AM to 5 PM.[/*]
[*][b]7 hearts, Professional Courtesy:[/b] the town square 9 AM to 3 PM.[/*]
[*][b]8 hearts, The Saloon Backroom Rendezvous:[/b] enter the Saloon 8 PM to 11 PM (7 hearts if you're romancing her).[/*]
[*][b]The Aliases:[/b] enter the Museum 9 AM to 5 PM with [b]3+ pieces of evidence[/b] (after the 6-heart event). It continues at home the same day.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Side stories[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Pam Has Heard Things:[/b] the Saloon 5 PM to 8 PM, after the 2-heart event, once rumours are going around.[/*]
[*][b]Talking to a Stranger:[/b] on your farm 5 PM to 7 PM at 3+ hearts. About a 30% chance per day.[/*]
[*][b]One Eye Open:[/b] the Mountain 7 PM to 11 PM at 4+ hearts.[/*]
[*][b]Marnie's Warning:[/b] Marnie's ranch 9 AM to 4 PM, after the 4-heart event.[/*]
[*][b]The Blacksmith's Bad Morning:[/b] the Blacksmith 9 AM to 4 PM, the day after the 8-heart event or later.[/*]
[*][b]The Receipt:[/b] the Blacksmith 9 AM to 4 PM, 3+ days after The Blacksmith's Bad Morning. Any earlier choice qualifies.[/*]
[*][b]Necklace appraisal (missed it?):[/b] after The Borrowed Necklace, visit the Blacksmith and choose [b]Case notes > Ask Clint for the necklace appraisal[/b].[/*]
[*][b]The Hearing:[/b] Winter 15 of Year 2 by default (HearingSeason, HearingDay and HearingYear in the Core config).[/*]
[/list]
[b]Quiet moments[/b] (8+ hearts, romance on, True Ending path still open)
[list]
[*][b]Rain on the Porch:[/b] a rainy spring day, 5 PM to 8 PM, outside within about 5 tiles of the farmhouse door. About a 25% chance per evening.[/*]
[*][b]The Song at the Window:[/b] winter, walk into the farmhouse between 8 PM and midnight. About a 5% chance per evening.[/*]
[*][b]Moonlight Jellies:[/b] talk to her at the festival.[/*]
[/list]
[b]True Ending[/b] (check [b]Case notes / True Ending[/b] for what's left)
[list=1]
[*][b]The Letter in the Drawer:[/b] a rainy winter morning, once your other requirements are met. Missing quiet moments cost score here on Normal and Brutal.[/*]
[*][b]Three Winters:[/b] 28+ days later, walk into the farmhouse 6 PM to 9 PM.[/*]
[*][b]The Phone Call She Never Made:[/b] in fall, 14+ days later, near the town square 10 AM to 4 PM.[/*]
[*][b]The Offer:[/b] 3+ days later, near the farmhouse door 8 PM to 11 PM, on a day it isn't raining.[/*]
[*]The Hearing then plays out differently, followed by [b]The Woman Behind the Mask[/b] on the porch that evening.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Night menu scenes[/b] (from 8 PM, click Sandra in the farmhouse)
Cooking together, late-night conversations, dinners, romance scenes, and dates at the river, under the stars, at the Saloon, the beach, the movie theater and the carnival in town.[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]True Ending heart gifts[/b][/size]
Give the actual item to Sandra normally. Your case notes show which ones you still need.
[spoiler]
[b]Normal and Brutal: all five, each in its own window[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Fairy Rose:[/b] on her birthday, [b]Fall 14[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Pearl:[/b] within [b]7 days after the 7-heart event[/b] (The Poisoned Well).[/*]
[*][b]Prismatic Shard:[/b] any time after the [b]8-heart event[/b] (The Saloon Backroom Rendezvous).[/*]
[*][b]Rabbit's Foot:[/b] within [b]7 days after The Aliases[/b] (the 9-heart event).[/*]
[*][b]Handwritten Letter:[/b] write it at the [b]Writing Desk[/b], then give it in [b]winter[/b], after the [b]6-heart event[/b] (The Town Council Warning).[/*]
[/list]
[b]Casual: any three different gifts, no time limits[/b]
[list]
[*]Fairy Rose any day.[/*]
[*]Pearl after the 7-heart event.[/*]
[*]Prismatic Shard after the 8-heart event.[/*]
[*]Rabbit's Foot after the 9-heart event.[/*]
[*]Handwritten Letter after the 6-heart event, in any season.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[line]

[size=4][b]Suspicion and scheme[/b][/size]
Sandra tracks two hidden values. Check them any time with the SMAPI console commands below.

[b]Suspicion[/b] (0 to 100) is how much [i]you[/i] suspect her. It changes with your choices in her scenes and with the evidence you find.
[list]
[*][b]0 to 24:[/b] Trusting[/*]
[*][b]25 to 49:[/b] Uneasy[/*]
[*][b]50 to 74:[/b] Wary[/*]
[*][b]75 to 100:[/b] Certain[/*]
[/list]Her daily dialogue changes with your tier.

[b]Scheme[/b] is how far her plan for the farm has got. It starts rising a few days after she arrives:
[list]
[*][b]It rises fastest when you trust her[/b] (Trusting ×1.5, Uneasy ×1, Wary ×0.6, Certain ×0.3).[/*]
[*]Every piece of evidence you've found slows it down.[/*]
[*]Some story choices speed it up or slow it down.[/*]
[*]It stops rising once the Hearing is over, and pauses while the Hearing is postponed.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Side effects[/b] (each can be turned off in the Core config)
[list]
[*][b]Money drain:[/b] some days she quietly takes 50 to 300g, capped by [b]MoneyDrainDailyCap[/b] (300 by default). She never takes you below [b]MoneyDrainFloor[/b] (500g). It's more likely when you trust her, and you get a note when it happens.[/*]
[*][b]Crop sabotage:[/b] a small share of crops, up to [b]SabotageMaxPercent[/b] (5% by default).[/*]
[*][b]Rumours:[/b] gossip around town that costs friendship with villagers until it's dealt with.[/*]
[/list]
[b]For the True Ending:[/b] keep Scheme at [b]60 or below[/b], and have Suspicion [b]between 30 and 70[/b] at the 5-, 6- and 7-heart events.

[b]Console commands[/b] (type them in the SMAPI window)
[list]
[*][b]sandra_status:[/b] shows her suspicion, scheme, flags and story timeline.[/*]
[*][b]tcg_ending:[/b] shows your remaining True Ending requirements (the same list as the case notes).[/*]
[*][b]sandra_routine:[/b] shows her plan for today.[/*]
[/list]None of these change your save.

[line]

[size=4][b]The True Ending and the Hearing[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]You don't need to lose or throw the Hearing.[/b] On the Hearing day (Winter 15 of Year 2 by default), if all of these are true, a scene called [b]Personal Reasons[/b] plays instead and the Hearing is postponed:
[list]
[*]The True Ending path is still open.[/*]
[*]You have 8+ hearts with Sandra.[/*]
[*]You're dating or married to her.[/*]
[/list]The postponement gives you time to reach the Year 3 requirement and the final scenes. After [b]The Offer[/b], the Hearing comes back as [b]The Hearing, Rewritten[/b].

If you aren't at 8 hearts and dating her by then, the normal Hearing happens and its outcome ends her story, which closes the True Ending. If the True Ending path closes while the Hearing is postponed, the Hearing is rescheduled for 28 days later.

On Casual the year requirement is Year 2, so the postponement matters less, but it works the same way.[/spoiler]

[line]

[color=#e69138]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Extract the download into your [b]Mods[/b] folder. You should have [b]three[/b] folders:
[list]
[*][b][CP] The Cunning Guest[/b][/*]
[*][b][SMAPI] The Cunning Guest Core[/b][/*]
[*][b][SMAPI] The Cunning Guest Bedtime[/b][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Updating:[/b] delete the old folders, then install all three new ones from the same download. Don't mix versions: the Core checks that its folders match and disables the wardrobe if they don't. Your saves are kept. If you used the old standalone "Sandra Seasonal Outfits" folders, remove them; that feature is built in now.

[line]
[color=#e69138]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size][/color]
Settings are created the first time you launch the game (or use Generic Mod Config Menu):
[list]
[*][b][SMAPI] The Cunning Guest Core/config.json:[/b] romance, money drain, crop sabotage, rumours, hearing date, dialogue tone, story scenes per day, night events, portrait size, daily routine and more.[/*]
[*][b][CP] The Cunning Guest:[/b] FestivalAppearances, plus FestivalAppearancesSVE and the SVETile options to move her at SVE festivals.[/*]
[*][b][SMAPI] The Cunning Guest Bedtime/config.json:[/b] Enabled and BedTime (24-hour time, default 2200 = 10 PM).[/*]
[/list][b]Low memory?[/b] Set [b]DetailedSprites: false[/b] in seasonal-outfits.json and [b]DetailedSprite: false[/b] in the Core config.

[line]

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]FAQ[/b][/size][/color]
[b]Does she go to festivals?[/b]
Yes, all eight, with or without SVE. If she stands somewhere odd, turn off [b]FestivalAppearances[/b] or move her with the [b]SVETile[/b] options.

[b]Where does she sleep?[/b]
From 10 PM she sleeps in the farmer's bed (the free half of a double bed). Once married, she uses the normal spouse bedtime. If the farmer is married to, or rooming with, someone else, she stays up.

[b]How do I trigger the quiet moments (spring rain porch, winter humming, Moonlight Jellies)?[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]Spring porch:[/b] rainy spring evening, 5 to 8 PM, outside within about 5 tiles of the farmhouse door. About a 25% chance each qualifying evening.[/*]
[*][b]Winter humming:[/b] winter, walk into the farmhouse between 8 PM and midnight. About a 5% chance each qualifying evening.[/*]
[*][b]Moonlight Jellies:[/b] talk to her at the festival.[/*]
[/list]Both evening moments need 8+ hearts, romance on, the True Ending path still open, and no other story scene that day. Each plays once per save. Coffee and tea don't affect them.[/spoiler]

[b]How do I reach the True Ending?[/b]
Open [b]Case notes / True Ending[/b] near Sandra for your remaining requirements. The final scenes (spoilers):
[spoiler]Letter in the Drawer (a rainy winter morning) → Three Winters (28+ days later, walk into the farmhouse 6 to 9 PM) → Harrow (fall, 14+ days later, town square 10 AM to 4 PM) → The Offer (3+ days later, porch 8 to 11 PM, not raining). Collect the quiet moments before Letter in the Drawer: on Normal and Brutal, missing ones cost True Ending score.[/spoiler]

[b]I missed the necklace appraisal or Clint's receipt.[/b]
After the 3-heart scene, visit the Blacksmith and choose [b]Case notes > Ask Clint for the necklace appraisal[/b]. For the receipt: after The Blacksmith's Bad Morning, go back to the Blacksmith between 9 AM and 4 PM at least three days later, on a day with no other story scene.

[b]Reporting a bug[/b]
Please post your SMAPI log: upload [b]SMAPI-latest.txt[/b] to [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url] and share the link.
